verdict.rationale: Whether a speech-AI service publishes its source under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. The evidence lists SDKs, a CLI and a self-hosted deployment option, but nothing states that any Deepgram source code is published under an open license. Self-hosting and SDK availability are adjacent features, not open-source licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
